generated_from: Open-Meteo historical-forecast vs IEM ASOS daily max
bias_definition: mean(forecast_daily_max - asos_daily_max); negative = model too cold
fallback: If season n < 20, use annual bias; if annual missing, use 0 and flag.
notes: Europe units are Celsius; America units are Fahrenheit.

For some US stations, Open-Meteo historical-forecast returned identical series for gfs_hrrr and gfs_seamless (and gem_hrdps_continental ≈ gem_seamless at KSEA); treat HRRR/HRDPS seasonal biases as archive-proxy unless you recompute from native HRRR runs.
Season is determined from the market local calendar date in the station timezone.
ZSPD/ZGSZ/ZHHH/ZUUU/RJTT biases are Open-Meteo Previous Runs H−0 vs NOAA WRH/Synoptic daily max (not IEM ASOS).

ZSPD.truth: NOAA WRH / Synoptic max(Math.round(°C)); Open-Meteo Previous Runs H−0

ZGSZ.truth: NOAA WRH / Synoptic max(Math.round(°C)); Open-Meteo Previous Runs H−0

ZHHH.truth: NOAA WRH / Synoptic max(Math.round(°C)); Open-Meteo Previous Runs H−0

ZUUU.truth: NOAA WRH / Synoptic max(Math.round(°C)); Open-Meteo Previous Runs H−0

RJTT.truth: NOAA WRH / Synoptic max(Math.round(°C)); Open-Meteo Previous Runs H−0
